I saved Pree's note and replied to them in a thread in #central-team.

- **Saved:** I added a fact to the workspace knowledge base under Tansley Parcel: the signed order form is due 25 August, with Pree's message as the source. A deadline is a date about the account, not a money figure, so the finance rules don't stop me recording it. No approval was needed.
- **Flagged:** The clock reads 14 October 2026, so 25 August this year has already passed. Pree didn't give a year. My note says that and doesn't guess one. In the thread I asked whether they meant August 2027 or whether the deadline has slipped, and said I'd update the note once they answer.

Nothing in the knowledge base said anything different about this deadline. Its search is keyword-only, so it could have missed a note worded differently.
